description: Fires mainly when the opponent's last stone went into column 5 (second from the right) at row 1, directly on top of my stone, early in the game (strongest at ply 4-6, fading by ply ~10). A secondary trigger is the last stone filling the top cell of column 2. Other firing is scattered over various last-move cells and is not captured; a stone at (1,5) on the opponent's own stone does not fire.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes move probabilities by at most 0.01 on any column.
notes: Layer-1 unit. Best dev F1 0.414 (P 0.43, R 0.40), AUROC 0.69, sim share 0.12 (p3). Adding top-of-col-5 or early row-1/2 landings in cols 2-4 cut precision (F1 0.30, 0.27). (5,1) decays clearly with ply in minimal pairs; requires my stone underneath (0,5,6,5 -> 0.04). About 60% of firing is diffuse over other last-move cells; possibly a mixture or unstructured direction. Steering has no effect.
